SELECT
    j.id AS job_id,
    j.lease_token,
    j.attempts,
    j.max_attempts,
    o.id AS order_id,
    o.shop_domain,
    o.shopify_order_id,
    o.order_number,
    o.external_reference,
    o.currency,
    o.total_amount,
    o.customer_data,
    o.raw_order,
    COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'sku', l.sku,
                'quantity', l.quantity,
                'unit_price', l.unit_price
            )
            ORDER BY l.id
        ) FILTER (WHERE l.id IS NOT NULL),
        '[]'::jsonb
    ) AS order_lines
FROM public.delivery_jobs AS j
JOIN public.orders AS o
    ON o.id = j.order_id
LEFT JOIN public.order_lines AS l
    ON l.order_id = o.id
WHERE j.id = $1::uuid
  AND j.lease_token = $2::uuid
  AND j.status = 'processing'
GROUP BY j.id, o.id;

const c={...$('QA Request Create').item.json};const r=$json;const status=Number(r.statusCode||0);let b=r.body;try{if(typeof b==='string')b=JSON.parse(b);}catch{}const fail=(m,permanent=true)=>({json:{qa_failed:true,statusCode:permanent?422:503,body:{result:permanent?'invalid':null,error:m}}});if(status<200||status>=300){const n=String(b?.name||'');return fail('Odoo '+c.qa_method+' failed HTTP '+status,[400,401,403,404,409,422].includes(status)||n.startsWith('odoo.exceptions.')||n.startsWith('builtins.'));}try{const id=Array.isArray(b)&&b.length===1?b[0]:b;if(!Number.isInteger(id)||id<=0)throw Error('Create response missing ID; reconcile by reference');c.qa_id=id;return {json:c};}catch(e){return fail(String(e.message));}

const c={...$('QA Request Readback').item.json};const r=$json;const status=Number(r.statusCode||0);let b=r.body;try{if(typeof b==='string')b=JSON.parse(b);}catch{}const fail=(m,permanent=true)=>({json:{qa_failed:true,statusCode:permanent?422:503,body:{result:permanent?'invalid':null,error:m}}});if(status<200||status>=300){const n=String(b?.name||'');return fail('Odoo '+c.qa_method+' failed HTTP '+status,[400,401,403,404,409,422].includes(status)||n.startsWith('odoo.exceptions.')||n.startsWith('builtins.'));}try{if(!Array.isArray(b)||b.length!==1)throw Error('Quotation unavailable');const o=b[0];if(o.state!=='draft'||o.client_order_ref!==c.qa_ref||o.partner_id?.[0]!==15||o.company_id?.[0]!==1||o.currency_id?.[1]!=='USD'||Math.abs(Number(o.amount_untaxed)-c.qa_subtotal)>0.005||Math.abs(Number(o.amount_tax)-c.qa_tax)>0.005||Math.abs(Number(o.amount_total)-c.qa_total)>0.005||o.order_line?.length!==1)throw Error('Quotation mismatch; retained ERP ID '+c.qa_id);c.qa_line_ids=o.order_line;return {json:c};}catch(e){return fail(String(e.message));}

const c={...$('QA Request Lines').item.json};const r=$json;const status=Number(r.statusCode||0);let b=r.body;try{if(typeof b==='string')b=JSON.parse(b);}catch{}const fail=(m,permanent=true)=>({json:{qa_failed:true,statusCode:permanent?422:503,body:{result:permanent?'invalid':null,error:m}}});if(status<200||status>=300){const n=String(b?.name||'');return fail('Odoo '+c.qa_method+' failed HTTP '+status,[400,401,403,404,409,422].includes(status)||n.startsWith('odoo.exceptions.')||n.startsWith('builtins.'));}try{if(!Array.isArray(b)||b.length!==1)throw Error('Line count mismatch');const l=b[0];if(l.product_id?.[0]!==42||Number(l.product_uom_qty)!==c.qa_qty||Number(l.price_unit)!==c.qa_price||Number(l.discount)!==0||JSON.stringify(l.tax_ids)!=='[1]'||Math.abs(Number(l.price_subtotal)-c.qa_subtotal)>0.005||Math.abs(Number(l.price_tax)-c.qa_tax)>0.005||Math.abs(Number(l.price_total)-c.qa_total)>0.005)throw Error('Line mismatch; retained ERP ID '+c.qa_id);return {json:c};}catch(e){return fail(String(e.message));}
